name: Facet
text: Default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a persistent, one-click toggle to light mode. This maximizes visibility and liveliness for our screencasts—dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light editing and highlight data clearly, while the toggle ensures accessibility for all viewers. The trade-off is slightly slower interface switching, but the clarity gain outweighs the minor delay.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Auto-switching fragments the interface—users see two modes, not one. A single high-contrast dark theme with a manual light toggle is safer; settle it by testing readability in both themes with users who need light mode.
